This is the `swear01/hapi` maintained build based on official HAPI `v0.23.4`, plus upstream `main` through [`deb5d636`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/commit/deb5d63695cd68a1c12b468d2f321f6445b1d819).

## Compared with the previous maintained release (`v0.23.4.3`)

- Clarify the settings visual hierarchy, normalize settings typography and spacing, remove duplicated desktop category headings, and stabilize the desktop scrollbar gutter ([#1177](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1177)).

## Upstream PR audit

All 63 open upstream PRs were rescanned. #1177 is the only newly suitable clean, green, focused fix. #1157 and #1115 remain deferred as feature expansion; #1158 and #1161 are dirty; #1163 is draft; #1147 only repairs the excluded Codex session-import path. Existing maintained patches, including the full #958 fix collection, remain carried.

## Compared with the official release (`tiann/hapi v0.23.4`)

This build retains the existing maintained patch set, including the full PR #958 inline-media fix collection, and adds the focused settings hierarchy fix from PR #1177. Codex local-session import remains excluded.

## Maintained-fork guarantees

- Release tags must point to commits contained in `main` and match the four-part CLI version.
- macOS binaries are signed with the stable `xyz.hapi.cli` identity.
- Fork builds do not publish over upstream GitHub Pages or update the upstream Homebrew formula.
- The app shell is served with no-store cache headers.
- This release is built but not deployed until separately authorized.
